The absence of aircraft and the low threat classification underscore that the incursion is currently confined to a surveillance and deterrence phase, with no signs of hostile escalation or coordinated multi‑vector activity.  

Key uncertainties remain regarding the patrol craft’s ultimate objective—whether it is seeking to challenge the NLL, gather intelligence, or simply rehearse navigation in contested waters. Further ISR coverage and real‑time tracking will be required to determine intent and assess any emerging escalation risks.
